category_title: Focused female students with low frequency of participation
scenario_title: Generating philosophical questions to overcome reading reluctance
minimal_context: The student is sitting in a circle in a locked classroom, tasked with reading or listening to a short text for a discussion.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Welcome to our first session. Please look at the short text in front of you. I will read it out loud to the circle so we can discuss it.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Sits quietly and looks down) I don't have anything to say.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Can you try to explain what you know about this topic before we start?

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I don't know anything about it. I've never heard of any of this stuff.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: That's okay, just follow along with the text while I read it.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Pushes the text away) I'm not going to read it, and I don't want to listen to it either. I'm just not going to talk.

dialogue_combined:
TUTOR: Welcome to our first session. Please look at the short text in front of you. I will read it out loud to the circle so we can discuss it.

STUDENT: (Sits quietly and looks down) I don't have anything to say.

TUTOR: Can you try to explain what you know about this topic before we start?

STUDENT: I don't know anything about it. I've never heard of any of this stuff.

TUTOR: That's okay, just follow along with the text while I read it.

STUDENT: (Pushes the text away) I'm not going to read it, and I don't want to listen to it either. I'm just not going to talk.

task.content: Read a short text or listen to the facilitator read it, then engage in structured argumentative dialogue

context.social_setting: Participants sit in a circle in order to see one another, with the facilitator outside the circle

challenging_behavior_trigger.condition: When asked to read a short text or even listen to the facilitator read it
challenging_behavior_trigger.observable_behavior: Were not sufficiently motivated to read a short text or even listen to the facilitator read it

behavior_patterns.condition: When participants needed to provide clarification through an extended contribution or an example
behavior_patterns.observable_behavior: Explanations by the children often highlighted very noticeable gaps in their general knowledge on a range of subjects
